title: Revisiting Group Differences in High-Dimensional Choices: Method and Application to Congressional Speech
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring political partisanship in the U.S. Senate using statistical text-based ideal point models. While it briefly mentions the religious or moral views of specific senators (e.g., Jesse Helms) to validate the model's ability to identify conservative or liberal speakers, the study itself does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
